steps.en: Pressing OK sends the suspension request for all selected notices at once.
steps.id: Menekan OK langsung mengirim permintaan suspension untuk semua notice terpilih.

steps.en: Each notice is suspended immediately under the chosen code.
steps.id: Setiap notice langsung disuspend dengan code yang dipilih.

steps.en: The public portal copy of the notice is updated at the same time.
steps.id: Salinan notice di portal publik ikut diperbarui bersamaan.
steps.why_en: A failed update of the public copy is only logged, while the officer is still told it succeeded.
steps.why_id: Kegagalan memperbarui salinan publik hanya dicatat di log, officer tetap diberi tahu berhasil.

steps.en: The officer is told whether the suspension succeeded.
steps.id: Officer diberi tahu apakah suspension berhasil.
steps.why_en: If the whole request fails, the screen still says it succeeded for zero notices instead of showing an error.
steps.why_id: Jika seluruh request gagal, layar tetap menyatakan berhasil untuk nol notice, bukan menampilkan error.
